placements.title: Transitioning to Velociraptor Retrospective Format
placements.frame: How does adopting the tripartite Velociraptor retrospective format structure sprint reflection and continuous process improvement?
placements.why: The segments establish the team's formal adoption of the Velociraptor retrospective format, detail its three-part structure (Sailed, Stalled, Capsized), and document the replacement of the previous start-stop-continue cadence.
